category.description: Type of place to search for near the given location (e.g., 'coffee shop', 'pharmacy', 'restaurant', 'gas station', 'hotel').
category.title: Category / Search Query

language.description: Language for Google Maps interface and results.
language.title: Language

location.description: Latitude / longitude center point. Object with 'lat' and 'lng' numeric fields.
location.title: Center Location

maxResults.description: Maximum number of places to extract. Google Maps returns at most 120 results per query.
maxResults.title: Max Results

minRating.description: Only include places rated at or above this value (1.0–5.0). Leave blank to include all.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

openNow.description: Keep only places Google reports as open right now. A place whose open/closed state cannot be read is dropped too, so every returned row is verified open and an openNow run can return fewer rows — even none — than an unfiltered run.
openNow.title: Open Now Only

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Datacenter IPs usually work fine for Google Maps; only enable if your runs are getting blocked.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

radiusKm.description: Search radius in kilometers. Used to pick the Google Maps zoom level (smaller radius = tighter zoom = more local results) and enforced as a hard filter: places beyond this radius are dropped.
radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
